_doc: Per-obligor operator-strength signals for CA charter muni universe v2. INDEPENDENT VARIABLE for upcoming CSFA LCFF intercept operator-signal-vs-spread test. Higher score = healthier operator (more likely to deserve tight spread). Used as exclusionary/regression covariate against bond spread.
_methodology: For every obligor in charter_universe_v2.json with confirmed bonds, pull 6 operator-side signals at point-in-time (current = late May 2026): (1) enrollment trajectory, (2) charter renewal status, (3) CAASPP academic performance, (4) LCFF per-pupil funding trajectory, (5) Form 990 / audit findings, (6) FCMAT review history. Apply transparent subscore rubric (-75 to +110) then normalize to 0-100.
_data_source_provenance: Three-source build: (a) Existing detector data files at verticals/muni_credit/data/charter_initial_detector_data/ — these are best-effort qualitative reads from CDE/Dataquest with cited URLs, NOT all fully primary-sourced. (b) Fresh WebSearch/WebFetch primary-source pulls on 2026-05-28 for obligors WITHOUT existing detector files + cross-checks. (c) charter_universe_v2.json audit-cleansed EINs and structure classes. Every subscore carries a source URL; UNVERIFIABLE used where signal couldn't be primary-sourced in pass.
_hostile_validator_stance: Prior charter scoping (v1) hallucinated 3 school closures (View Park, both Aveson). v2 audit corrected. This signal file does NOT score schools or events that were debunked. Aveson distress is REAL in FY24 990 but obligor is pcsd_lease structure (bond-invisible) so excluded from this universe. ICEF score uses RECOVERING profile (+90% revenue FY20-FY24) not v1's 'distressed'.

scoring_rubric._unverifiable_handling: Subscores marked UNVERIFIABLE are excluded from the raw_total AND from the (110-(-75)=185) denominator's max/min. The effective denominator shrinks. Document n_verifiable_subscores per obligor.

score_distribution_summary._distribution_observation: Most obligors cluster 75-90 — narrow band reflects (a) absence of FCMAT reviews on this universe in 5yr window = uniform +10 for everyone, (b) clean Form 990s for 6+ obligors = uniform +20, (c) 'no near-term renewal risk' as default for obligors without verified distress. The score floor is determined by ICEF (54) which is the only obligor with VERIFIED bottom-quintile CAASPP + declining LCFF + declining enrollment that aren't masked. Stockton Collegiate (59) is second-lowest based on verified bottom-quintile math but most subscores UNVERIFIABLE.
score_distribution_summary._warning_score_inflation_from_unverifiab: The normalization-denominator-shrink approach means obligors with HIGH UNVERIFIABLE rates can score artificially HIGH if their few verified subscores are positive (e.g., Ednovate 94, Bright Star 87, PUC 87, Caliber 87 all have ≤4 verifiable subscores). These should be treated as LOW-CONFIDENCE scores in the spread test.

top_3_weakest_operator_signal_for_spread.why: Only obligor with 6 verified subscores AND verified bottom-quintile academic performance + declining LCFF + declining enrollment. The 'intercept-masks-operator-weakness' canonical case if intercept is doing its job, ICEF spread should be tighter than its operator signals justify.
Verified bottom-quintile math (17%); $5.7M 2024 par = small obligor. Smaller-scale CSFA-intercept candidate. Test whether 90-145 bps spread band holds for genuinely weak operators.
Active SFUSD renewal cycle + FRAGILE 3-subscore profile. As cscda_no_intercept = control group, useful as 'weak operator without intercept protection' comparison case.

csfa_intercept_signal_variance_for_test_._caveat_only_6_full_verified_subscore_ob: Within high-confidence (n=6 subscores) csfa_intercept obligors: Aspire 81, KIPP SoCal 81, Da Vinci 89, Granada Hills 89, El Camino Real 81, Green Dot 81, ICEF 54. Range = 54-89 = 35-point spread. ICEF is the lone outlier; the other 6 cluster 81-89 (8-pt range). TEST POWER caveat: cluster compression means most CSFA-intercept obligors will provide LITTLE discriminative power for the spread-vs-signal regression. ICEF + Stockton Collegiate (low scores) + Capitol Collegiate (UNVERIFIABLE) are the swing observations.
csfa_intercept_signal_variance_for_test_.implication_for_test_design: With 6 high-confidence csfa_intercept observations in the 81-89 range plus 1 outlier (ICEF 54), the spread-test will have low statistical power for testing whether spread tracks operator strength WITHIN the csfa_intercept group. The 3 cscda_no_intercept obligors (Lighthouse 88, High Tech High 81, Gateway 74) provide cross-structural comparison but are themselves a small sample. Test should: (a) include ALL 19 csfa_intercept observations weighted by n_verifiable_subscores, (b) report effect sizes with confidence intervals reflecting FRAGILE scores, (c) compare csfa_intercept vs cscda_no_intercept median spreads at each signal-quintile bucket.

cscda_no_intercept_signal_variance._observation: Spread of 14 points across 3 obligors — moderate variance. Not a huge sample for a control group but enough for a directional comparison vs csfa_intercept group.

_data_quality_notes: This file is a hybrid of (a) 10 pre-existing detector data files (CDE/Dataquest qualitative reads with cited URLs — 'best-effort public-record qualitative reads' per their own provenance note) and (b) fresh primary-source WebSearch/WebFetch pulls 2026-05-28 covering the obligors not in (a). Six obligors have a full 6-subscore verified profile (Aspire, KIPP SoCal, Da Vinci, Granada Hills, El Camino Real, Green Dot, ICEF). The remainder have 3-5 verified subscores with the rest UNVERIFIABLE. The score normalization handles UNVERIFIABLE by shrinking the denominator — this can INFLATE scores for obligors with few verified subscores if those subscores are positive. Flagged obligors with this inflation risk: Ednovate (94, 4 subscores), Bright Star (87, 4), PUC (87, 4), Caliber (87, 4), Larchmont (83, 3), Camino Nuevo (83, 3). These should be treated as low-confidence in the regression. Use n_verifiable_subscores as the precision weight in the spread test.
